bullets.title: NVDA: $500B AI infrastructure financing platform mobilizes Wall Street capital
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley reiterates Overweight on NVDA with $288 PT; Jensen Huang announced a $500B third-party capital mobilization with Apollo, Blackstone, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman, and KKR. NVDA co-invests up to 25%, reducing circularity concerns while revenue-sharing deals could deliver 100% gross margin annuity income and 10%+ FY29 EPS upside. The structure frames GPU compute as infrastructure with residual value, a more strategically significant development than the headline figure.

bullets.title: INTC: Upsizes equity offering to $20B at $95/share on massive demand
bullets.body: Intel priced 210.5M shares at $95/share (vs $97.52 prior close), raising ~$19.7B vs. original $15B plan on $100B+ of demand. Proceeds earmarked for capex and working capital. Analyst commentary frames the fundraise as a confidence signal in sustained AI infrastructure demand and Intel's advanced packaging/purpose-built silicon positioning.

bullets.title: APP: BofA downgrades to Neutral, cuts PT to $400 from $430
bullets.body: BofA downgraded AppLovin from Buy to Neutral and cut the PT to $400 from $430. Stock is down ~1.9% in pre-market. No additional detail provided in the notes on the specific thesis shift.

bullets.title: HIMS: Q2 revenue beat but EPS miss and gross margin disappointment drag stock -6.6%
bullets.body: HIMS reported Q2 revenue of $753M (beat $700M estimate) but swung to a net loss of $86.3M; EPS of -$0.37 missed the -$0.05 consensus. Gross margin missed by 280bps with 1,200bps YoY decline. Morgan Stanley maintained Equal-Weight with PT $28; Q3 revenue guided $880-900M and FY revenue raised to $3.10-3.30B but weak free cash flow and margin trajectory are concerns. Company also testing new peptide ingredients including BPC-157.

bullets.title: NET: Prices $2.175B 0% convertible notes at 60% premium; FedRamp certification adds
bullets.body: Cloudflare priced $2.175B of 0% convertible senior notes due 2031 at an initial conversion price of ~$496.94/share, representing a ~60% premium to the $310.59 close on Aug 10. Stock is down ~1.3% pre-market. Separately, NET received FedRamp certification, expanding federal market eligibility.

bullets.title: MDB: Citi raises PT to $545, reiterates Buy with upside catalyst watch on Sept 1 earnings
bullets.body: Citi raises MongoDB PT to $545 (11x F28 EV/Sales) on accelerating Atlas growth (~30% YoY for Q2/FY27 vs street at ~26%) and AI-native momentum building with new foundational model wins. Download activity (npm js) accelerating 100%+ vs 80%+ prior quarter. Citi also initiates a 90-day upside catalyst watch ahead of Sept 1 earnings, Citi conference, and investor day.

bullets.title: LITE: Bullish pre-earnings setup; needs $1.3B+ Sept guide and GM>50% to hold gains
bullets.body: LITE guided FY26 revenue to at least $1,003M (in-line) with gross margins 48.5%+ and EPS 3-4% above $3.00 estimate. The September quarter is expected to guide $1,150M-$1,200M representing ~120% YoY growth, though CPO deployment delays and rising InP supply pressures are key risks. Citi's hardware dinner survey found investors favor LITE over COHR 2:1 for year-end outperformance.

bullets.title: COHR: Needs $2.35B+ Sept revenue guide and CPO win details to outperform post-earnings
bullets.body: Per Citi's hardware dinner, COHR needs September revenue of $2.35B+ (10% above consensus) and concrete CPO win details to satisfy investors. Investors remain divided, with COHR lagging LITE in preference. Earnings reporting window is this week alongside LITE.

bullets.title: FSLR: Baird upgrades to Outperform, raises PT to $318 from $205 (33% upside)
bullets.body: Baird's Ben Kallo upgraded First Solar from Neutral to Outperform and lifted the price target to $318 from $205, implying 33% upside from the $239.33 close. FactSet consensus stands at $277. Stock is up 3.6% pre-market.

bullets.title: TTD: Viant (DSP) Q2 beat with CTV momentum seen as share gain opportunity vs TTD
bullets.body: DSP Q2 revenue of $104.3M (+34% YoY) beat consensus with AEBITDA of $14.2M above the $13.6M guided. DSP Q3 guidance of $107.5-110.5M topped estimates. Analysts flag DSP's first-party CTV data capabilities as positioned to capture share amid customer defections at TTD; TTD cited as the competitor most at risk.

bullets.title: CSCO: Piper views FY27 guide as de-risked; estimates moving higher; reports Wednesday
bullets.body: Piper sees Cisco's FY27 guidance as de-risked with infrastructure vendors broadly seeing estimate revisions higher on DRAM price reacceleration and AI networking demand. CSCO reports Wednesday Aug 12 after market close with consensus at $1.17 EPS / $16.82B revenue.

bullets.title: CRWV: JPM maintains Neutral with $110 Dec-27 PT; near-term margin limits upside
bullets.body: CoreWeave is a recognized leader in AI compute scaling but JPM keeps Neutral citing F3Q operating margin forecast of 7.0% vs 7.5% consensus, limiting near-term positive catalysts. GPU rental prices are up 21% YTD for Ampere/Hopper and 32% for Blackwell, with the founder removing 10b5-1 selling plans. $2.6B delayed draw term loan was also closed.

bullets.title: AAPL: Jefferies downgrades to Sell on cancelled glass iPhone model cutting ASP growth
bullets.body: Jefferies downgraded Apple to Sell citing cancellation of the all-glass iPhone model, which cuts estimated iPhone ASP CAGR FY26-31 from 9.0% to 6.8%. Rising memory costs add further margin pressure. Separately, reports emerged contradicting the cancellation narrative, with some sources indicating Apple is still proceeding with a glass-centric iPhone redesign for the 20th anniversary model. Memory will represent over 40% of iPhone 18 Pro BOM cost per UBS.

bullets.title: META: Zuckerberg signals 'substantially stronger models' arriving soon; $1B community fund
bullets.body: Zuckerberg told interviewers META is 'very close to having substantially stronger models' as the company outbuilds in the recursive self-improvement race. META also released a lightweight open-source AI model and a new watermelon-scale pretrained model is anticipated. Meta separately announced a $1B 'Future Is For Everyone' Fund to support communities hosting AI data centers.

bullets.title: MSFT: Planning major Maia 300 AI chip ramp with TSMC; RSI at 79, largest premium to 200DMA since October
bullets.body: Microsoft is planning to unveil its next-gen Maia 300 AI accelerator as early as this fall, targeting 300k+ units from TSMC in 2027 with a goal of reducing NVIDIA reliance in Azure inference. MSFT is trading at the largest premium to its 200-day moving average since October, with RSI near 79, and was flagged by Jefferies as seeing the largest net buying in Infrastructure Software over the past two weeks.

bullets.title: DELL/HPE: Both preferred AI server plays; Morgan Stanley upgrades HPE to OW
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley upgraded HPE to Overweight citing chipflation-driven server and storage spending acceleration. DELL remains a preferred play at Citi and Piper on sustained AI server demand. AlphaWise survey confirms cycle driven by refresh, pull-forward, and AI; server cycle expected to roll over 2027-2028.

bullets.title: HUBS/NOW/TEAM: Featured at Oppenheimer and Jefferies TMT conferences Tuesday-Thursday
bullets.body: Oppenheimer's TMT Conference (Tue-Thu, all virtual) lists AMD, NOW, TEAM, LRCX, HUBS, KLAC, TXN, and ADBE in its top 10 most-requested company meetings. Separately, Infrastructure Software was flagged as seeing the largest net buying among tech subsectors over the past two weeks per Jefferies flows data.

bullets.title: TSLA: China domestic retail sales -33% YoY in July; exports surge +143% YoY
bullets.body: Tesla domestic retail sales in China fell to ~27.2k units in July (-33% YoY / -48% MoM) while exports surged 66.3k units (+143% YoY / +83% MoM). NEV retail penetration hit 65.1% in July. Tesla also announced first Cybercab with Starlink integration and is seeing continued constructive investor sentiment on Physical AI and FSD, though robotaxi execution remains key for greater conviction.

bullets.title: PLTR: Michael Burry increases put position, values stock at under $1; risk-reward debate
bullets.body: Michael Burry has been accumulating PLTR put options and publicly states the stock is worth under $1, while others note Burry incorrectly called for S&P decline in January 2023 (market doubled afterward). PLTR trades at 72x TTM price-to-sales per Bilello data. Stock was +37% on S&P 500 inclusion.

bullets.title: VST/CEG/BE: ERCOT Batch Zero delays create near-term headwinds for IPPs; BTM plays benefit
bullets.body: ERCOT filed a formal request to delay Batch Zero amid Gov. Abbott's audit quasi-moratorium on new data center grid connections starting post-Aug 20 review. Morgan Stanley expects high-quality projects (HUT, CEG, VST) to experience only temporary 1-3 month delays, while behind-the-meter plays including BE and SEI are seen accelerating in 2H26 if grid delays persist. TLN upgraded 2027-28 FCF guidance implying 11-14% FCF-to-equity yields.
